# Audio: 00:00.000 => 00:40.375

Transcript
```
WEBVTT

00:00.830 --> 00:02.670
<v Customer 1>Thank you for calling Fabrikam Billing.

00:03.310 --> 00:04.190
<v Customer 1>How may I help?

00:05.950 --> 00:10.110
<v Customer 1>I have a question about fictional invoice AW2048.

00:10.990 --> 00:12.990
<v Customer 1>The delivery fee appears twice.

00:14.590 --> 00:17.230
<v Customer 1>I reviewed the sample account and confirmed the duplicate fee.

00:17.870 --> 00:19.790
<v Customer 1>I will issue a $35 credit.

00:20.430 --> 00:23.630
<v Customer 1>The case number is BILL4902.

00:25.470 --> 00:26.030
<v Customer 1>Thank you.

00:27.070 --> 00:29.790
<v Customer 1>Please send the credit confirmation by e-mail.

00:31.310 --> 00:32.990
<v Customer 1>The confirmation will be sent today.

00:33.710 --> 00:34.830
<v Customer 1>Is there anything else?

00:36.590 --> 00:36.990
<v Customer 1>No.

00:37.870 --> 00:39.630
<v Customer 1>That resolves the billing issue.
```

Summary.valueString: A caller to Fabrikam Billing reported a duplicate delivery fee on fictional invoice AW2048. After reviewing the sample account, the agent confirmed the duplicate charge, issued a $35 credit, and provided case number BILL4902. The agent agreed to send a credit confirmation by email the same day, and the caller confirmed the billing issue was resolved.

valueArray.valueString: Email confirmation and case number BILL4902
